audit_resolution.P0_01_resolved: Static configs in settings.json / court.json yield SnapshotStatus.STATIC_SPEC, never false CAPTURED.
audit_resolution.P0_02_resolved: Preflight requires live CAPTURED baseline and non-mock authorization to enter READY; static or mock yields BLOCKED.
audit_resolution.P0_03_resolved: Dry-run observations marked NOT_OBSERVED or OFFLINE_FIXTURE, never RECORDED.
audit_resolution.P0_04_resolved: R06 is_comparable_with strictly requires identical save_id and engine_path in addition to context parameters.
audit_resolution.P1_05_resolved: VAEKnowledgeRevisionManager supports durable JSONL file ledger; fresh instances reload keys and deduplicate.
audit_resolution.P1_06_resolved: TechnicalReadback explicitly structures and reports discrete L0, L1, L2, L3 verification layers.
audit_resolution.P1_07_resolved: VAEEvaluationEngine uses non-causal trend outcomes (OBSERVED_TREND_POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/NO_APPARENT_CHANGE); requires controls for CONFIRMED_CONTROLLED.
audit_resolution.P1_08_resolved: settings.json min=70 vs default=40 explicitly documented in evidence dossier as OPEN_SOURCE_DEFECT / UNKNOWN.
audit_resolution.P1_09_resolved: Contract and checkpoints updated with honest resolution states and test oracles.
audit_resolution.P2_10_resolved: Direct execution of 4 auditor counterexamples and expanded negative assertions in pytest suite.
audit_resolution.P2_11_resolved: E2-E4 documented and validated as bounded contract guards, not operational native execution.
audit_resolution.P2_12_resolved: Tooling limitations (e.g. 2-team trade adapter) separated from engine impossibility; dynamic engine support remains UNKNOWN.
audit_resolution.F02_resolved: R06 enforces save_id, engine_path, side, controller, dual normalize, quarter lengths, and base_source.
audit_resolution.F03_resolved: R08 initial status strictly PENDING_REVISION; transitions to APPENDED only upon confirmed ledger commit.
audit_resolution.F04_resolved: R08 includes deterministic SHA256 idempotency key and append-only deduplication.
audit_resolution.F05_resolved: Comprehensive deterministic oracles and negative counterexamples implemented.
audit_resolution.F06_resolved: Strict evidence hierarchy enforced; non-game sources marked STATIC_SPEC / OFFLINE_FIXTURE / UNKNOWN.
audit_resolution.F07_resolved: Explicit blocked-state (R03) and not-run (R04) nullability rules validated.
